6064629688529256825.description: A raven to sell to the Abbot of the Pillars.

6064630010917486593.title: Neon Gryphon
6064630010917486593.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Veiled in luminous hues that ripple like auroras across midnight skies, the Neon Gryphon moves through the world with a spectral majesty that defies natural law. Its feathers pulse with shifting light, casting glows of violet, emerald, and cobalt as it flies above the moonstruck rooftops of Winstead. Muscles coil beneath its radiant frame, silent and poised, while its eyes burn with an intelligence both ancient and otherworldly. Born of storms that never touched the ground and dreams whispered in crystal caverns, the Neon Gryphon is a symbol of insight, vigilance, and visionary rule. It binds itself only to the Mayor of Winstead, whose will must shine as brightly and as strangely as the mount they command.

6064630140415049841.title: Apprentice Herbalist Breeches
6064630140415049841.description: "Begin from beneath," teaches the Master Herbalist. "Even mighty blooms grow from dirt."

6064630140770582657.title: Journeyman Armorsmith's Tool Belt
6064630140770582657.description: A belt seared by sparks and soot, shaped to cradle the weight of iron and ambition. It cinches with purpose before the first hammer falls.

6064630141186212013.title: Apprentice Lumber Miller's Pants
6064630141186212013.description: Woven from bark-linen and padded at the seams, these pants were designed to endure sawdust, sweat, and the weight of learning.

6064630197017968712.title: The Oubliette
6064630197017968712.description: A metallic orb of arcane design. Engraving reads, 'Property of the Carphin Chronological Society.'

6064630367563481323.title: The Twilight Crescent
6064630367563481323.description: Crafted in the style of a rare blade found buried for three centuries beneath the ruins of a forgotten monastery. The herbs it cuts wither not, but weep sap like tears and bloom again, elsewhere.

6064630378768826369.title: Vest of Verdant Excess
6064630378768826369.description: More herbs than you ever meant to grab... and then, one more for Lotharia, Goddess of Indulgence!

6064630650088980484.title: Forsaken Blades Mace
6064630650088980484.description: Etched with the sigil of the Forsaken Blades, this mace is issued only to those who've proven their place in blood. It is not earned. It is survived.

6064630657027997924.title: Ashen Haunt's Breastplate
6064630657027997924.description: An unsettling presence seems to linger within this heavy armor--not a curse, but a memory of the grave. Mortals with the nerve to don it might actually draw strength.

6064630657027997987.title: Ashen Haunt's Greaves
6064630657027997987.description: These greaves echo with an eerie cadence behind each step. In moments of stillness, they seem to urge their wearer onward.

6064630678670868481.title: Spider Silk Gloves
6064630678670868481.description: Silk this fine should tear--but never does. It molds to your hands like a second intention.

6064631007189663766.description: The thick parchment has taken great damage from the elements. Whoever lost this was using it to map their way to a hidden dig site.

6064631120995876873.title: Wyrmling
6064631120995876873.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Clad in bronze scales that shimmer like sunlit armor, the Wyrmling is the ember-born offspring of a militant legacy. Though small in stature, it carries the spirit of an ancient fire, coiled tight within a frame still learning its place in the skies. Its breath is smoke and promise, its eyes twin coals that burn with challenge and curiosity. Tempered by flame and ferocity, it yields to no hand that has not earned its trust through trial. Once bound, however, its loyalty is fierce and unshakable, a bond forged not by dominance, but by mutual will. The Mayor of Aithanahr holds that bond, rising into the storm-laced heavens astride a creature that may yet grow into legend.

The Mayor of Halcyon holds that bond, rising into the storm-laced heavens astride a creature that may yet grow into legend.

6064631121018880021.title: Pridestrider
6064631121018880021.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: The Pridestrider moves with the solemn grace of a living myth, a mount woven from the breath of storms and the silence of sacred groves. Its head bears the visage of a white lion, regal and unyielding, crowned with a pair of straight, gleaming horns that rise like spears of moonstone toward the heavens. The torso is that of a great gorilla, heavy with primal strength and steady as a mountain?s heart. Its wings, vast and fragile in appearance, unfold in shimmering layers like the breath of a butterfly caught between worlds, scattering iridescent light with each beat. The Pridestrider does not gallop or glide but commands the air with the authority of a sovereign spirit. It answers only to the Mayor of Miraleth, whose dominion must hold the weight of law and the lightness of vision in equal measure.

6064631121070456874.title: Eagle Gryphon
6064631121070456874.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Cloaked in wind and crowned in sunlight, the Eagle Gryphon reigns over the skies with a presence both regal and unrelenting. Its wings span like the banners of forgotten empires, each feather sharp with purpose and etched with the memory of high places. The lion's strength coils beneath its taloned grace, and its cry carries like a trumpet over stone and treetop. Forged in the thin air of ancient mountain thrones, the Eagle Gryphon is a creature of clarity and command, drawn to those who rule not with secrecy but with vision cast wide and true. It serves the Mayor of Winstead alone, recognizing in them the soul of a leader who does not follow the path but charts it.

6064631159636361221.description: Though loose and unsuitable for normal play after reassembly, this ancient figure was originally crafted with utmost care and infused with its maker's essence to preserve it. Holding it, you can almost feel a familial warmth within.

6064631159955324935.title: Toy Soldier Head
6064631159955324935.description: The head of an ancient toy soldier that's survived well past when it ought to have thanks to ancient magics within. Could be reassembled with the other pieces.

6064631160017125391.description: The paper this letter is inked on feels so old it could disintegrate. Against time and your gentle handling, it holds together.

6064631205379571851.title: Fishscale Blade
6064631205379571851.description: A gleaming, agile sword forged with aquatic inspiration, as fluid in motion as the river beasts it emulates. Its cuts are not loud, but they are remembered.

6064631205527093467.title: Fiery Gem
more: A brilliant gem culled from the enchanted ring of a fire mage.

6064631206432997813.title: Bearslayer Skin
6064631206432997813.description: Rugged and resilient, this bearhide shirt exudes a raw, primal aesthetic with a defiant toughness that will turn the sharpest blade.

6064631206455017937.title: Morellius's Mad Cap
6064631206455017937.description: Banned from three courts and six taverns--this cap simultaneously inspires confidence in the wearer, and discomfort in the room.

6064631211418583865.description: A weapon carved from earth not to resemble flesh, but to defy it. Its core pulses with buried strength, and its strikes echo like thunder through a cavern that remembers everything it has crushed.

6064633050285277184.title: Scorpion
more: Scorpix are a rare and monstrous breed of Scorpion said to be the direct spawn of Skla'risha, the Mother of Pain, a legendary predator that stalks the cursed core of the Sandsquall Desert. Larger than typical Scorpions and far more aggressive, Scorpix bear their mother's terrifying signature?a split tail tipped with twin venomous stingers. Their darkened carapace is thick as stone, and their blood-red eyes glow faintly in moonlight. Though notoriously difficult to tame, a trained Scorpix becomes a formidable mount, galloping over dunes with shocking speed and lashing out with brutal precision at any threat.

6064633288743256073.title: Notched Avian Bone
6064633288743256073.description:
Drop: Kesetal 
Ingredient In: Arcane Engineering
more: A slender bone, riddled with peculiar notches and grooves, clearly not naturally formed. The light, hollow structure and thin walls reveal an avian origin. The notches, uneven and crudely carved, suggest an unsettling attempt at unnatural assembly.

6064633289002713101.title: Broken Iron Links
6064633289002713101.description:
Drop: Captain Bulwark 
Ingredient In: Armorsmithing
more: Twisted, rusted iron links, once hand-pinned chainmail, now mangled and split. Stout impact has flattened some, and bent others. With a lot of work, they could be straightened and re-used.

6064633289012609055.title: Bellsong's Everlasting Shol Coal
6064633289012609055.description:
Drop: Bilgehook 
Ingredient In: Arcane Engineering
more: Twice as heavy, burns thrice as long. That's Bellsong's Promise! Originally produced only for lighthouses, now available in workshop packages!

6064633289013198883.title: Twisted Badlands Haft
6064633289013198883.description: The sturdy haft of a hammer or mace, wrought of some petrified badlands wood that has been twisted into shape.

6064633289711157501.title: Conservator's Gloves
6064633289711157501.description: Igni enjoyed collecting strange objects from his travels, especially dangerous ones. These gloves, tailored specifically for handling cursed objects, were one of the most important parts of his kit.

6064633289735471428.title: The Furnace Anvil
6064633289735471428.description: Crafted by the Dwarven smith Thraldir, this hammer was forged at great risk within the treacherous Pyrespire Vent. The hammer's power is enhanced by Pyresteel, a rare alloy forged in the vent's volatile heat.

6064633289800679846.title: Twinblaze Wand
6064633289800679846.description: Among the Dreadtide goblins of Subalfire Lighthouse, only the Voice of Flames was permitted to commune with and relay the wishes of their resident deity, the Burnmonger.

6064633290466394115.title: Ornate Owl
6064633290466394115.description: A small owl carved from ornate marble that radiates a freeing aura drawing you to the base of Carphin Tower.

6064633293513293928.title: Recipe: Dunzentine Daggers
6064633293513293928.description: Journeyman Weaponsmithing recipe for dual Dunzentine daggers.

6064633294940209152.title: Wisp Whelk
6064633294940209152.description: Captured by a Journeyman Hunter and ready to train.

6064633311409340517.title: Fresh Cut of Iguana Meat
6064633311409340517.description: Iguana meat is a culinary delicacy among the clans in the Turquoise Sea. This rare and rejuvenating ingredient provides rich and complex flavors when paired with Nikuan spices and prepared with expert culinary technique.

6064633312135086450.title: Slayer's Medallion
6064633312135086450.description:
Drop: Elite Enemies

more: A trophy from slaying challenging enemies.

6064633328413179961.description:
Process: Lumber Milling

6064633385240035328.title: Crate of Djinna Dried Fish
6064633385240035328.description:
This crate is packed with Djinna's finest dried fish, great for rations when moving through a barren desert.

This item can be delivered to the Guild Commodity Vendor in a settlement to earn Guild XP.

You can drop this item using the Drop Crate ability.
more: Enchanting Essence

Purchase: Laboratory, Laboratory: Scribing's Workshop, Citizen Vendor 
Ingredient In: Scribing

A shimmering vial of pure magical potential, distilled from the whispers of ancient spells. This rare reagent binds enchantments to the physical world, serving as the crucial catalyst in crafting powerful scrolls that amplifies powerful equipment.

6064633413840339966.title: Siege Declaration Banner - Squall's End
6064633413840339966.description:
A level 15 or above player can use this banner to declare a siege against Squall's End.

Seek out a stone platform by the marketplace in Squall's End to place this banner.

6064633419021811718.title: Novice Tempering Kit - Artisan
6064633419021811718.description:
A small, sturdy wooden box, polished to a soft sheen. Inside, nestled in compartments lined with dark velvet, are collected the required elements of magical enchantment. The lid is adorned with a small emblem, signifying the type of gear the kit is designed to enhance.
This kit can only be used on equipment of equal or lesser grade than itself; attempts to temper higher-tier gear are magically inhibited and cannot even be initiated.

6064633419686805517.title: Journeyman Tempering Kit - Artisan
6064633419686805517.description:
A small, sturdy wooden box, polished to a soft sheen. Inside, nestled in compartments lined with dark velvet, are collected the required elements of magical enchantment. The lid is adorned with a small emblem, signifying the type of gear the kit is designed to enhance.
This kit can only be used on equipment of equal or lesser grade than itself; attempts to temper higher-tier gear are magically inhibited and cannot even be initiated.

6064633429412020239.title: Siege Declaration Banner - Arisalon
6064633429412020239.description:
A level 15 or above player can use this banner to declare a siege against Arisalon.

Seek out a stone platform near the marketplace of Arisalon to place this banner.

6064633447762558988.title: Barnacle Buckler
6064633447762558988.description: Barnacle Brenn and her Jundark Raiders were one of the few seafarers to survive an encounter with the mighty Undertow, the titan crab! The pirate queen is said to have leaped upon the shell of the beast and pried one of the magical barnacles from its back. Mounted upon a buckler, it's now her greatest trophy and defense.

6064633453068616129.title: Breaching Pickaxe
6064633453068616129.description: Designed by the famous spelunker, Jenry the Strong, the Breaching Pickaxe was standard issue to all rescuers tasked with the recovery of lost researchers.

6064633453612564941.title: Recipe: Warden Shillelagh
6064633453612564941.description: Journeyman Weaponsmithing recipe for Warden Shillelagh.

6064633454093861336.title: Recipe: The Mirror Helm
6064633454093861336.description: Journeyman Leatherworking recipe for The Mirror Helm.

6064633461758689281.title: Cacao Rooting Ball
6064633461758689281.description: This self-fertilizing root ball that will grow a cacoa tree when planted in a freehold.

6064633498934378504.title: Braidwood Seed
more: Braidwood seed can be used to grow a braidwood tree.

6064633527214801309.title: Sparkveil Gloves
6064633527214801309.description: Close with the fine precision of a jeweler's touch, steady and sure whether on tool haft or sword hilt.

6064633571794092037.title: TEST_Deployable_Footprint_Small_Box
6064633571794092037.description: Right click this item start deployment

6064633605980028928.title: Dawnbreaker
6064633605980028928.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Cloaked in shimmerwoven aether and kissed by the first light of the celestial dawn, the Mayoral Dawnbreaker of Mythbreak is no ordinary flying mount. Its form, a sublime fusion of ancient magic and primal grace, defies natural order: the musculature of a great owlbear, the ringed tail of a dusk-born rakari, and the multicolored, translucent wings of a butterfly. It is a living sigil of authority, arcana, and awe.

6064633605993791491.title: Rose Gryphon
6064633605993791491.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Bathed in the blush of dawn and crowned in petals of gilded crimson, the Rose Gryphon soars as the resplendent guardian of Tangled Post's verdant vales and flowering highlands. A rare and radiant kin of the storied Gryphon line, it bears the sinewed might of a lion entwined with the luminous grace of a rose-hued eagle. Its wings shimmer with iridescent hues, catching the light like stained glass in a cathedral of wind and bloom. The Rose Gryphon is a symbol not only of courage and command but of beauty in defiance, strength rooted in elegance. It answers to no rider save the Mayor of Tangled Post, whose sovereignty is woven with the same paradox the creature embodies: fierce gentility, and a will that blooms even in blood-soaked soil.

6064633605994643460.title: Phoenix Gryphon
6064633605994643460.description:
Flying Mount
Level 25

165% Ground Speed
215% Flying Speed
500% Maximum Health
more: Wreathed in embers and crowned with flame-kissed plumage, the Phoenix Gryphon blazes across the skies above Arisalon like a living omen of rebirth and wrath. Its leonine frame radiates heat with every bound, while its wings unfurl in a brilliant flare of copper and gold, trailing sparks that never fall. Forged in volcanic storms and tempered by centuries of wildfire, it carries with it the legacy of survival through ruin and triumph through trial. A creature of myth made manifest, the Phoenix Gryphon symbolizes more than strength and leadership; it is the embodiment of relentless resurgence. Only the Mayor of Arisalon may claim its loyalty, for only one who has endured fire without being consumed may ride such a mount.

6064633651060342786.title: Latchlip
6064633651060342786.description: Can be plucked from the water by a Grandmaster Fisher.

6064633729795555330.title: Small Practice Crate
6064633729795555330.description:
A crate that can be packed to carry more materials than the average person can hold. Small crates can be transported by a player, caravan, or ship.

Crates may be interacted with in the Harbor or Caravansary menus.

This Crate is for Practice -- It cannot be traded, nor sold. Speak to a caravan assistant to learn more about crates. Equipping a packed crate will end PvP protection.
more: Sealed Letter
An urgent message from Runescribe Flinthelm to Commander Thraen Dunzchasm.

6064633741453885462.title: IOU
6064633741453885462.description: I owe you one radical tier 2 crafting recipe.

6064633765023383577.title: Dhurgrum Siege Contract
6064633765023383577.description:
Purchase: Dhurgrum Barracks 
Ingredient In: Tailoring

sources.name: Bring the Runecarved Gem to Chieftain Sanvi

6064633855580307516.title: Furnace Moss
6064633855580307516.description:
Gather: Anvils 
Ingredient In: Alchemy, Weaving

6064633860905959425.title: Stonechant Vestment
6064633860905959425.description: Resonates with low hums in places where walls have heard too much.

6064633860905959427.title: Stonechant Trousers
6064633860905959427.description: Never tears, but thins in places where silence once rang loudest.

6064633860905959431.title: Stonechant Sash
6064633860905959431.description: Wraps itself into place when the mouth is closed but the throat prepares to speak.

6064633860907139092.title: Oathdelve Treads
6064633860907139092.description: Dust gathers only when the wearer is spoken of, not when they walk.

6064633860908187682.title: Tithebrook Sash
6064633860908187682.description: Cinches sharply when debts are spoken aloud, and looses when they are paid.

6064633860908646441.title: Hallowmark Mantle
6064633860908646441.description: Worn by those who turned their backs on the altar without permission.

6064633860910743617.title: Scorchwander Boots
6064633860910743617.description: Dust never clings long to these boots, as if the sands themselves refuse to touch them. Those who walk in them speak of trails remembered only by wind and sun.

6064633860916773029.title: Gritmantle Leggings
6064633860916773029.description: Cut for the long march across open ground, they flex easily through every stride while keeping the frame guarded.

6064633860917166251.title: Veilrender Cape
6064633860917166251.description: A trailing shroud that drinks in the dimness, shifting like smoke among the trees until it becomes part of the gloom itself.

6064633860917166253.title: Veilrender Sabatons
6064633860917166253.description: Close-wrapped to silence the footfall on sodden loam, each step pressing softly into the mulch where roots curl unseen.

6064633860917166258.title: Veilrender Belt
6064633860917166258.description: A binding of interwoven strands, its clasp blackened to erase any glint, cinching the whole together in quiet, deliberate readiness.

6064633860919066833.title: Dunecoil Boots
6064633860919066833.description: Grip both loose sand and hard-packed ground, the tread rolling forward with the steady rhythm of a caravan crossing the wastes.

6064633860920312037.title: Wildmarch Bracers
6064633860920312037.description: Bound close around the forearm, they turn aside briar and brush without slowing the hand that wears them.

6064633860920574188.title: Coalhewn Boots
6064633860920574188.description: Grip stone and shale with the certainty of a miner?s step, built to carry their weight through both tunnel and battlement.

6064633860920901877.title: Tidepiercer Boots
6064633860920901877.description: High-cut for the shallows, each step shedding water through hidden seams, the soles gripping wet timber and coral rock alike.

6064633860921229564.title: Scorchmantle Cape
6064633860921229564.description: A wind-cutting drape whose trailing edge bears the faded scorchmarks of old embers, warding its wearer from sun glare and sudden storms alike.

6064633860947050786.title: Deepward Bastion Sabatons
6064633860947050786.description: Chiseled with fracture lines that never spread, these boots once paced the broken paths between emberfall and hall. Ash clings to their soles like memory refusing to fade.

6064633860947050792.title: Deepward Bastion Girdle
6064633860947050792.description: Fastened by clasp-stones carved with the mark of the Hollow Forge, this belt held firm when all else fell away. The metal still feels warm, though the fire was lost long ago.

6064633860947509548.title: Glenwarden Bracers
6064633860947509548.description: Worn smooth by quiet watch, these bracers were made to brush aside bramble without disturbing what listens in the underbrush. They feel cool in sunlight, as if shaded by memory.

6064633860948164914.title: Undermarch Watcher?s Cloak
6064633860948164914.description: This heavy cloak carries the scent of forge ash and the faint shimmer of soot-scored thread. Once worn by those who walked the long tunnels alone, it falls still in places without echo.

6064633860948164916.title: Undermarch Boots
6064633860948164916.description: Built for balance on narrow ledges and slag-hewn stairs, these boots grip stone with a miner's surety. Their weight builds rhythm, not burden.

6064633860948164921.title: Undermarch Shoulders
6064633860948164921.description: These pauldrons are layered in iron bands stamped with the same sigil repeated, over and over, as if no single mark could suffice. Each bears the dull gleam of purpose, not pride.

6064633860949147974.title: Crownbreaker Sabatons
6064633860949147974.description: Each step in these greaves disturbs the hush of ancient roads. They were shod in haste for those who marched across flooded barrows and stood unmoved against encroaching tide and time.

6064633860950917459.title: Luminous Concord Greaves
6064633860950917459.description: Originally forged alongside the rest in the veiled forges of Moltruin, these greaves settle with uncommon balance. Each motion feels deliberate, as though the stone beneath yields only to those with purpose.

6064633860971561303.title: Stormcanon Cuirass
6064633860971561303.description: Forged in the hush between wave and thunder, this cuirass bears the stillness that comes before upheaval. Its weight draws the breath deep, anchoring resolve beneath salt-worn skies.

6064633860971823457.title: Sunwrought Sabatons
6064633860971823457.description: Grains of scorched glass still cling to the seams, as though the wearer once walked paths sealed by lightning and sand, beneath a sky that no longer remembers rain.

6064633860983357858.title: Moltruin Gauntlets
6064633860983357858.description: Grip with the certainty of stone hardened in fire, each movement carrying the memory of the forge that birthed them.

6064633860983685550.title: Brineplate Pauldrons
6064633860983685550.description: Stand as the high cliffs before the open sea, lifting the bearer above the tide of battle with unbreakable presence.

6064633860983947700.title: Sunbastion Gauntlets
6064633860983947700.description: Close over the hands with the sureness of a builder's hold, steady enough for the heaviest blow or the finest adjustment.

6064633860987224554.title: Stoneglen Gauntlets
6064633860987224554.description: Close around the hands with the grip of a gatekeeper's hold, unyielding until the way is secure.

6064633860987945465.title: Reefguard Cuirass
6064633860987945465.description: Holds the body as the reef holds its place against the endless surf, each curve shaped for strength that does not yield to time or tide.

6064633860987945467.title: Reefguard Bracers
6064633860987945467.description: Clasp the forearms in the same steady embrace as coral branches locking together against the pull of the deep.

6064633860988666376.title: Sandbastion Pauldrons
6064633860988666376.description: Rise from the shoulders like the towers of a desert citadel, their shape turning aside the strike as well as the blowing sand.

6064633860997710361.title: Emberwake Bindings
6064633860997710361.description: Tight as ritual bindings and etched with faint lines that appear only at dusk.

6064633860998562344.title: Runebreath Sash
6064633860998562344.description: Tightens or loosens at will, guided by cadence rather than hand.

6064633860999086639.title: Ashwoke Legwraps
6064633860999086639.description: Woven for silent movement over stone and soot, these wraps bend with the hush of a held breath.

6064633860999086645.title: Ashwoke Grips
6064633860999086645.description: These gloves were worn by ashbound monks who moved coal with bare hands. Their palms carry the ghost of heat.

6064633860999479868.title: Candlefen Mantle
6064633860999479868.description: Hung with stillness and soft weight, it answers only to unlit flame.

6064633861004657228.title: Unfallen Rainment Belt
6064633861004657228.description: Braided with strands said to be plucked from storm-tossed nets, this belt bears the steady weight of ocean rituals. It binds not just raiment but resolve, drawn tight by generations who braved the shifting tides.

6064633861010424483.title: Dustwhisper Hood
6064633861010424483.description: Draws forward over the eyes, breaking the glare and letting the wearer's gaze sweep the dunes unseen.

6064633861010424488.title: Dustwhisper Boots
6064633861010424488.description: Step without a sound on dune or stone, the tread pressing into sand with the quiet precision of a shadow passing overhead.

6064633861010752179.title: Shadeweft Gloves
6064633861010752179.description: Close without stiffness, their touch steady for drawing a bowstring or easing through a tight gap in the undergrowth.

6064633861012062901.title: Thistledown Hood
6064633861012062901.description: Falls loosely to frame the face in shadow, softening the outline so it blends with the sway of field and branch.

6064633861012062903.description: Lie close and smooth, shedding stray thorns or branches before they can catch in the weave.

6064633861012259523.title: Glimmersoot Boots
6064633861012259523.description: Tread with the confidence of one who knows the stone beneath, steady across slick forgescales or the loose gravel of a mining path.

6064633861012718291.title: Veilsand Sash
6064633861012718291.description: Ties the set together with a quiet knot, the ends stirring in the same slow pattern as the sand carried by the breeze.

6064633861012980445.title: Wraithskin Jerkin
6064633861012980445.description: Worn close for silence and speed, its weave catches no light, allowing the wearer to slip between tree and vine unseen.

6064633861014029041.title: Ashveil Bracers
6064633861014029041.description: Wrap the forearms with a grip as certain as a climber's handhold, light enough for speed yet steady enough to turn a strike.

6064633861014029043.title: Ashveil Cape
6064633861014029043.description: Trails in soft, smoke-grey folds that shift like forge-ash caught in a high wind, masking the wearer's outline against stone and shadow.

6064633861014291189.title: Seawisp Leggings
6064633861014291189.description: Move with a fluid sway, their cut allowing long strides whether crossing sandbars or climbing rigging.

6064633861014553349.title: Duneflare Cape
6064633861014553349.description: Streams behind like a banner of heat-haze, its edges lifting with every gust as though carrying a fragment of the desert wind itself.

6064633861014881031.title: Nightwhisper Leggings
6064633861014881031.description: Move as easily in a crouch as in a sprint, their fit unbinding and silent in the close, humid air.

6064633861399314433.title: Rusty Rapier
6064633861399314433.description: Once an elegant blade now rusted, not with misuse but time.  Yet the point is sharp and her attacks swift.  She's survived vast amount of time, let her guide you to your own survival.

6064633866776608799.title: Forgebound Necklace
6064633866776608799.description: Shaped in the deep workshops of Stonevein, where strikes echo longer than memory, this talisman holds the rhythm of practiced hands. Its bearer often feels pulled toward the center of any line held true.

6064633866782638135.title: Scorchbound Necklace
6064633866782638135.description: A sun kissed disc with a faint ring of singe at the rim, heat haze seems to waver across its face in the brightest noon.

6064633866789322829.title: Shadebound Earrings
6064633866789322829.description: Slivers as dark as water under dense canopy, cut so they swallow the glint that finds them. In stillness they seem to drift, the way shadows drift when the jungle holds its breath.

6064633866935861329.title: Mistwood Hand Axe
6064633866935861329.description: Crafted beneath the canopy where fog never lifts and the bark runs dark with dew, the Mistwood Hand Axe holds the scent of damp moss and distant thunder. Its edge never gleams, no matter the light, and the grain of its haft is smooth as riverstone. Those who carry it often find their steps quieter, and the trees more watchful.

6064633866937434196.title: Runeweld Hand Axe
6064633866937434196.description: Forged on an anvil etched with forgotten glyphs, the Runeweld Hand Axe bears markings along its spine that no longer match any known dialect. When gripped tightly, the runes deepen in color, as though inked anew. Old smiths say these blades were never meant to be sharpened by mundane tools, and should never be left near sleeping stone.

6064633866957553752.title: Sandcarved Axe
6064633866957553752.description: Scored by wind and sun in the outer reaches, this blade balances grit with silence. Each strike lands as if already buried beneath dust.

6064633867064508525.title: Stormcurrent Axe
6064633867064508525.description: The head draws long with a prowlike sweep, built for decisive cuts that ride the rhythm of wind and wave.

6064633867081023605.title: Mistwood Great Axe
6064633867081023605.description: Hewn in the half-light beneath veiled boughs, the Mistwood Great Axe carries the scent of rain-damp bark and slow decay. Its haft is always cool to the touch, and birds go silent when it's drawn.

6064633867088494725.title: Sunfire Great Axe
6064633867088494725.description: A warm, field-bright hue lives in the metal, steady as noon on open pasture.

6064633867093672076.title: Wavecutter Great Axe
6064633867093672076.description: A deep keel line and lifted toe let it part mass cleanly, the form bred for decisive entries and easy release.

6064633867128144071.title: Dreadwake Twin Daggers
6064633867128144071.description: River dark metal with low shine, edges drawn for work where light thins under roots.

6064633867172446411.title: Runeweld Focus
6064633867172446411.description: Carved with sigils no longer taught, the Runeweld Focus hums faintly when forgotten names are spoken aloud. It grows heavier in places where magic once was.

6064633867177951447.title: Shadowfang Focus
6064633867177951447.description: Its surface seems to dim the air around it, drawing in stray light.

6064633867203838219.title: Nightreaver Mace
6064633867203838219.description: A matte surface dims the light, its weight speaking in quiet, patient intent.

6064633867211702548.title: Verdant Oath Great Mace
6064633867211702548.description: The Verdant Oath Great Mace strikes with the force of falling timber and the weight of old rain. Blossoms wilt where it rests, then bloom again when it is gone.

6064633867211964693.title: Runeweld Great Mace
6064633867211964693.description: Etched with worn glyphs and balanced like a chant, the Runeweld Great Mace swings with rhythm rather than force. Its strikes leave behind faint echoes, even in open air.

6064633867213078809.title: Sandcarved Great Mace
6064633867213078809.description: Worn smooth by endless desert winds, this mace echoes with dry whispers and sun-bleached silence. It feels older than its wielder, as if it remembers battles that were never written down.

6064633867215962403.title: Sunfire Great Mace
6064633867215962403.description: A warm, field bright hue lives in the metal, never showy, always sure.

6064633867218649391.title: Stormcurrent Great Mace
6064633867218649391.description: Lines sweep like weather over open water, momentum carried clean.

6064633867218846000.title: Glassveil Great Mace
6064633867218846000.description: Mirage clear facets bloom and fade as the light shifts.

6064633867226382650.title: Thornbound Rapier
6064633867226382650.description: Knotted with unseen intent, the blade weaves through air like a trailing vine, each motion guided by the unseen hand of a hidden grove.

6064633867243749740.title: Stormcurrent Scepter
6064633867243749740.description: Cool to the touch, with lines that channel a steady pull like tide under moon.

6064633867247026547.title: Coralblade Shield
6064633867247026547.description: Raised against storm and spell alike, this shield bears the hush of the ocean trench. Its face shimmers with a pressure-born gleam, as though the sea itself still leans behind it.

6064633867257250195.title: Flameheart Shortbow
6064633867257250195.description: Fine temper lines drift the limbs like smoke that chose to linger.

6064633895599865859.title: Mount Cosmetic: Radiant Stallion
6064633895599865859.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Gleaming like the first light of dawn, the Radiant Stallion seems less ridden than revered. Its golden coat shines with an inner brilliance, while its steady gait inspires courage in those who ride beside it. Often chosen by paladins and ceremonial guards, this noble steed carries both pride and purpose across every battlefield and boulevard.

6064633895777009761.title: Mount Cosmetic: Grave Beast
6064633895777009761.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: With bones hardened like forged iron and breath that chills the air, the Grave Beast rises from burial grounds untouched by time. Its massive frame moves with slow purpose, each step echoing the silence of ancient tombs. Bound by old magic and darker intent, it bears the weight of forgotten oaths and broken pacts. Riders who claim one often speak of dreams haunted by voices not their own and paths that lead where the living rarely tread.

6064633895804797043.title: Mount Cosmetic: Veteran Aurite Drake
6064633895804797043.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your flying mount.
more: Clad in glinting aurite and bearing the scars of countless battles, the Veteran Aurite Drake is a living testament to war?s endurance. Once ridden by commanders of fallen legions, it now serves as a mount for those who seek strength tempered by experience. Its wings beat like war drums, and its roar echoes with memories of hard-won victory.

6064633895810891895.title: Mount Cosmetic: Stormsnapper Rangefinder
6064633895810891895.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Electric-eyed and clad in scale, the Stormsnapper Rangefinder was bred for scouting in the most volatile skies. It navigates windshear and stormfronts with uncanny precision, its senses honed to pierce through rain and fog. A favored mount of skywatchers and aerial tacticians, it is both pathfinder and protector in the tempest above.

6064634489924419589.title: Anchor of the Shattered Will
6064634489924419589.description: This focus is a jagged construct of fixed form and broken order. It hums with a deep, tectonic rhythm, like stone remembering movement. The surface is angular, sharp with geometry that defies mapping, as though once whole and now held in place by force alone. When clenched, its weight shifts subtly ? never balanced, but always certain. It does not channel energy. It asserts presence.

6064634489929072648.title: Griefcarver
6064634489929072648.description: Forged in silence, this axe is shaped like a wound that never closed. Its jagged head cleaves not with might, but with mourning, made solid. The haft is wrapped in bands etched with motionless spirals - the marks of memories buried too deep to speak. It is not a weapon raised in rage, but in the slow, crushing sorrow of inevitability.

6064634518646292581.title: Dreadful Duo
6064634518646292581.description: These twin blades are perfectly balanced but never aligned, curving away from one another like severed paths. Their surfaces are dulled by erosion, as if scraped smooth by years adrift in the void. Along the flat of each dagger runs a faint spiral groove, shallow and endless, never quite meeting its own origin. They are not weapons of precision, but of discord; instruments designed to end a rhythm by cutting between its beats.

6064634518670147737.title: Bracers of the Unwound Thread
6064634518670147737.description: These bracers feel incomplete, not by damage, but by design. Thin lines spiral inward across their surface, each curve tighter than the last, never touching the center. Where they fasten, faint indentations suggest a second pair of arms that once wore them, long forgotten. They seem to breathe slightly when held near sources of stillness.

6064634597678710785.title: Unworded Vow
6064634597678710785.description: Shaped from coalesced stillness at the heart of the Jundark, this sword hums with restrained, unspoken power. A low, persistent resonance follows its motion: a vibration not heard, but felt in the marrow. Along the blade's fuller are veins of blacklight that pulse only when spoken truths are silenced. To wield it is to wield a forgotten promise: once powerful, now poisoned by time and void.

6064634597679890434.title: Undertongue
6064634597679890434.description: Pulled from a shipwreck crushed under coral centuries ago, this trident thrums with the weight of swallowed oaths. Its barbed prongs curve inward unnaturally, as if meant to pierce truth before it surfaces. Where its haft meets the base, clusters of hardened kelp pulse faintly, like knotted veins around a song never sung. It is not wielded, but dragged forward by some unseen current. One that always leads to silence.

6064634618906935363.title: Fisherman's Shirt
6064634618906935363.description: Light and loose, this shirt flutters like a lure cast wide. The fabric smells faintly of brine and stories.

6064634618948288597.title: Animal Husbandrist's Shirt
6064634618948288597.description: Spun to wick sweat and shrug off fur, this shirt works where hands must soothe. Its quiet strength lies in rolled sleeves and always-roomy pockets.

6064634618950713430.title: Alchemist's Skivvies
6064634618950713430.description: Crafted from breathable weave and toughened thread, these pants offer comfort without sacrificing utility. Deep, vial-sized pockets hint at a life lived between formulas and fire.

6064634619044167777.title: Crafter's Shirt Box
more: A shirt to start you on your first steps into crafting!

6064634642912444475.description: A customized ship helm for medium sized ships.
more: (Certain Ship Stats are currently Work In Progress, may not function as intended.)

6064634654088233071.title: Lost Vestment
6064634654088233071.description: For those that wander, where ever they be lost...

6064634654088233073.title: Lost Grips
6064634654088233073.description: Grip your fate with the strength to forge forward.

6064634654088298618.title: Lost Pauldrons
6064634654088298618.description: The weight of the old world may settle upon your shoulders.

6064634654088298624.title: Wanderlust Trousers
6064634654088298624.description: Travel across the lands through portals beyond.

6064634654234247330.title: Wanderer's Ranged Weapon Chest
more: Where ever your eye may wander, may you be prepared.

6064634673789927442.title: Tool Buckle Set
6064634673789927442.description:
Purchase: Smithing Workshop

Ingredient In: Armorsmithing
more: Assorted belt buckles, loops, and rivets forged in bulk. Required for constructing dependable toolbelts that hold up under weight.

6064634674844467213.title: Medallion of Return
6064634674844467213.description: Issued under seal of the Kaelar Empire.  An iron chain and pendant honoring the divine mandate of return - prophesied by the Light Pact, and fulfilled by the courage of the Kaelar people.  Proof of lawful entry to Verra. Must be surrendered up request by any Imperial officer.

6064634674852069390.title: Barabead Strand
6064634674852069390.description: Hand-carved from shell by Shoreguard Punga, each bead marks a bond - an emblem of trust, and of Nikuan family found beneath the mountain.

6064634680745852936.title: Dusty Family Journal
6064634680745852936.description: A timeworn journal stamped with a tower and star. The faded entries describe a household sworn to Warhelm, determined to stand their ground no matter the cost.

6064634716560103270.title: 29 (Light Magical) Brightgrove - Rare
6064634716560103270.description: Grants a set of gear and weapons.

6064634722064990208.title: Cosmetic: Gilded Scarab
6064634722064990208.description: This cosmetic will override the visual look of your ground mount.
more: Clad in metallic plates and crowned with golden color, the Golden Beetle is a living relic of old glory. Once used by royal courts to carry envoys and banners across sun-drenched roads, these massive insects still carry themselves with silent poise and unwavering discipline. Though slow to provoke, they are fiercely protective of their riders and capable of remarkable endurance. A symbol of bygone power, the Golden Beetle remains a noble companion for those who value tradition and quiet strength.

6064634762077339657.title: Hauler's Oath Reliquery
6064634762077339657.description: This focus was built to guide tireless labor through dark veins of stone. Its markings log shifts, routes, and silent prayers for safe return. When called upon, it steadies the mind like a foreman?s hand on your shoulder.

6064634762084220959.title: Duunhold Treadstones
6064634762084220959.description: Boots once issued to the outer wardens of Duunhold, blessed for long watches in bitter wind. They carry a slow, relentless cadence, urging the wearer to keep moving, even when the road turns to ruin.

6064634767638986856.title: Watcher's Splitcord
6064634767638986856.description:
Drop: Sergeant Smect 
Ingredient In: Carpentry
more: Stripped from the last intact bow at Hawkwatch, this frayed bowstring was ritually cut to honor fallen sentries.

6064634767641018480.title: Runaway's Handstitch
more: Blood-stiffened scrap of fingerwrap left on a shrine stone. Still bears the half-carved prayer of a deserter.

6064634767641739380.title: Hallwarden's Rebuke Head
6064634767641739380.description:
Drop: Grudda Ironpot 
Ingredient In: Weaponsmithing
more: Ceremonial mace-head with rebuke sigils etched by a master scriptor. Whispered to echo only when striking traitors.

6064634767642263671.title: Poacher's Trailpoint
6064634767642263671.description:
Drop: Grigg the Poacher 
Ingredient In: Weaponsmithing
more: A sharpened wood spike marked with Grigg's first trailkill. Dark resin clings to the grain.

6064634773953249282.title: Fumitor Seed
6064634773953249282.description:
Purchase: Agriculatural Supply: Farming Supply 
Ingredient In: Farming
more: Fumitor seed can be used to grow Fumitor plants.
